values.meaning: duration of the mark that allows recast
values.quote: marks... the enemy or the last ''{{ai|Twilight Shroud|Akali|smoke}}'' section hit for 3 seconds, during which ''Shuriken Flip'' can be recast to consume the mark
values.binNote: Wiki-only value; no corresponding bin data value found for this text-described duration.

mechanics.claim: The initial cast fires a shuriken projectile that deals magic damage to the first enemy hit and marks that target (or the last Twilight Shroud smoke section hit) for 3 seconds, allowing a recast.
mechanics.quote: throws a shuriken in the target direction that deals {{as|magic damage}} to the first enemy hit... The shuriken ''marks'' and {{tip|true sight|reveals}} the enemy or the last ''{{ai|Twilight Shroud|Akali|smoke}}'' section hit for 3 seconds, during which ''Shuriken Flip'' can be recast to consume the mark.

mechanics.claim: The recast is a separate cast that dashes Akali to the marked target and deals magic damage upon arrival, so it is a second damage instance distinct from the initial cast.
mechanics.quote: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Akali''' {{tip|dash|dashes}} towards the marked target or smoke section. Against enemies she deals {{as|magic damage}} upon arrival.

mechanics.claim: Both the initial cast and the recast count as separate ability activations for on-cast effects.
mechanics.quote: Both casts count as ability activations for the purposes of on-cast effects such as {{tip|Spellblade}} and triggering {{ais|Force Pulse|Kassadin}} passive.

mechanics.claim: Cooldown starts on the initial cast, not on the recast.
This ability's damage (both casts) is calculated based on Akali's stats at the moment of application, not at cast time.
mechanics.quote: This ability's damage is calculated based on the caster's stats at the time of its application.

mechanics.claim: Killing the marked enemy with the initial shuriken still leaves the last Twilight Shroud section hit marked, preserving a valid recast target.
mechanics.quote: Killing an enemy with the shuriken will still mark the last area of the {{ai|Twilight Shroud|Akali|shroud}} hit.

mechanics.claim: After the recast dash, Akali is automatically ordered to basic attack the target, which can chain an attack (and its reset/on-hit effects) immediately after the E2 damage.
mechanics.quote: '''Akali''' will be ordered to basic attack the target after the recast's dash ends.
